Thanks Hannah — passing to the panel.

Team — please confirm your final numeric scores in the attached scorecard by EOD today. We need to:
1) Lock and merge scores into a single canonical doc.
2) Decide whether to schedule a 30-min follow-up coding tiebreak (if disagreement > 1 point on technical axis).
3) Assign someone to write a 1-line hire/no-hire rationale for the packet.

I created a shared Drive link for the canonical scorecard: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/feedback-REQ-4821

Quick asks:
- Laura: can you confirm your technical score + whether you'd support hire?
- Marissa: if you have concerns, flag them inline and propose what you'd need to flip.
- Tessa: can you own the short rationale doc if we decide to hire?

Thanks — I'll consolidate once everyone posts.

Subject: Re: Candidate feedback packet: Miles Ortega

Ben — posted my numbers in the scorecard (see attached). TL;DR: technical 3.5/5, systems design 4/5, culture 5/5, overall 3.8.

Notes (short):
- Strong practical knowledge of KV cache eviction patterns and tradeoffs.
- Hesitant on API consistency for complex batch/stream flows; wanted clearer error-handling examples.
- Would be comfortable hiring with a short ramp and a follow-up pairing session to validate API clarity.

I can take a quick 20-min pairing with him if we decide that's the path.

Laura Bennett
Senior Staff Engineer
Redwood Inference
Attachments: laura_score_snapshot.png
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2026 16:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate feedback packet: Miles Ortega

Opened the scorecard — I put technical 2/5, systems design 2.5/5, culture 4/5, overall 2.5.

Concerns (concise):
- Several whiteboard gaps around API failure modes. For the scale we operate at, I need stronger evidence of designing for partial failures and retry semantics.
- Coding problem: passed but solutions were brittle (edge-case handling missing).

If the hiring manager (Ben) still wants to move forward, I propose a focused 30-min tiebreak on API failure/retry design with me and Laura observing. If he can't demonstrate that, I would vote no.

Marissa Cole
Engineering Manager, Runtime Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.example.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.example.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example.com>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.example.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:48:00 -0700
Subject: FINAL: merge + next steps for Miles Ortega (REQ-4821)

Thanks all for the quick turn. Summary and next steps:

- Scores are split but close: panel average overall ~3.4. Technical variance between Marissa (2.5) and Laura (3.8) is the largest gap.
- Action: schedule a focused 30-min API failure/retry tiebreak with Marissa + Laura as observers. Hannah, can you check Miles' availability tomorrow (Wed) 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 14:00–16:00 PT?
- Owner: Marissa to run the tiebreak interview (she will bring two targeted prompts).
- Post-tiebreak: Marissa will update the canonical scorecard within 1 hour of the call and post a one-line hire/no-hire recommendation.
- If recommendation = hire, Tessa will draft the short rationale doc and I'll route to Recruiting for offer prep.

I've attached the consolidated canonical scorecard (consolidated_scorecard_v1.pdf). Please don't edit the file in Drive — we'll publish v1 after the tiebreak.

Ben Carter
Hiring Manager, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
